interpretation: Three stars and zero forks do not support a claim of organic growth.
The 235 unique clones are not equivalent to 235 readers because they are much higher than the 13 unique visitors and may include automation, mirrors or CI.
No third-party directory referral was visible in the public referrer sample; open submissions and listed entries are not counted as distribution results.
The next growth decision should prioritize a real external audience or a maintainer-accepted listing, then measure unique visitors and calculator use rather than adding more duplicate submissions.
